sn14.11:1.4: This set of seven offers a unique perspective on familiar meditations.  “Beauty” (_subha_) is the focus of wholly pure and exalted meditation, such as the meditation on love, or the sight of a pure brilliant color like the sky ([mn77:22.6]()).
sn14.11:3.2: At [an6.41:2.7](), Sāriputta explains that an accomplished meditator could see a tree as nothing but beauty or nothing but ugliness, since both of those elements are present in it.
